src.utils.seed 源代码

import os
import torch
import random
import numpy as np

__all__ = ["seed_all"]




[文档]
def seed_all(seed):
    os.environ["PL_GLOBAL_SEED"] = str(seed)
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
